name: Xchange2
source:
Take on the role of Takuya Aihara, the unlucky chemistry student at Miyanomori Private School, who has a tendency to get caught in bizarre chemistry accidents that cause you many problems. When a strange chemical turned you into a girl last year, you had a bizarre string of experiences as you learned "how the other half lived." Now, one year later, you're enjoying your school life with Asuka, your steady girlfriend. But unhappy days are around the corner, as chemistry club member Chisato uses you as a guinea pig for a new experiment, which changes you into a girl once again!

As a girl, you find you're much more popular than before, but with practically everyone around you (both male and female) yearning to have sex with you, it can all get to be too much.

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20140908144206/http://www.peachprincess.com/x-change-2.html]Peach Princess[/url]]
translation:
扮演相原拓也，宫之森私立学校那位不幸的化学系学生——他总是卷入各种离奇的化学事故中，给自己带来无尽的麻烦。去年一种奇怪的化学品将他变成了女孩，他经历了一系列奇异的体验，学会了“另一半的生活方式”。如今一年过去了，他正和稳定的女友飞鸟享受着校园生活。但不幸的日子即将来临，化学社成员千里将他当作新实验的小白鼠，再一次把他变成了女孩！

作为女孩，你发现自己比以前受欢迎多了，但周围几乎所有人（无论男女）都渴望与你发生关系，这一切可能会让人难以承受。

[引自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20140908144206/http://www.peachprincess.com/x-change-2.html]Peach Princess[/url]]
